<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex003032026-05-0402-13-35" status="unreviewed"> 
   <milestone unit="section" n="v. 12"/>
      <lg> <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">rje btsun klu sgrub</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">chos skyon</rs>g<anchor xml:id="a17"/> dang<anchor xml:id="a18"/> ||</l> <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">dbyig gnyen</rs> sogs kyi gsal mdzad <lb edRef="inst:4458" n="8a7"/> do/de ||</l>
  <l>'on kyang shin du mthar thug par ||</l><l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">mtshan nyid rnam 'grel mdzad pa</rs>s<note type="editorial">Reference to Dignaga and Dharmakirti, the authors of the "mtshan nyid" and the "rnam 'grel" - the expression is borrowed from SDV</note> phye ||</l></lg>
  
  des<anchor xml:id="a19"/> gsal bar mdzad pa ni <rs type="person"><abbr>slob dpon</abbr> 'phags pa klu sgrub</rs> <lb edRef="inst:4458" n="8a8"/> <abbr>la sogs</abbr> pa dang | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference"><abbr>slob dpon</abbr> chos skyong</rs> dang | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">dbyig gnyen</rs> <abbr>la sogs</abbr> pa ste | 'on kyang shin du gsal zhing zur phyin pa ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference"><abbr>slob dpon</abbr> btsun ba phyogs kyi glang po</rs>s <lb edRef="inst:4458" n="8b1"/> rnam par bzhag pa'o ||
  de ni de nyid kyi slob ma <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">slob dpon dbang phyug sde</rs> la sogs pas kyang ji lta bar ma phyed pa las<anchor xml:id="a20"/> ¦ dus phyis lho phyogs kyi rgyud du byung ba rigs pa'i <lb edRef="inst:4458" n="8b2"/> rgyal po <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">slob dpon dpal chos kyi grags pa</rs> rgyal sras kun du bzang po'i sprul par grags pa 
  <note type="gloss">tshad ma'i lus rgyas 'bring bsdus pa ston pa rnaM 'grel ¦ rnaM nges ¦ rigs thigs 3 dang ¦ yan lag ston pa <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5831">gtan tshigs thigs pa</rs> ¦ rgyud gzhan sgrub pa ¦ 'brel pa brtag pa ¦ rtsod pa'i rigs pa ste bzhi</note> 
  des tshad ma'i bstan bcos chen po sde bdun gyis legs par phye'o ||</seg></TEI>
